findings.label: Stale snapshot after a mid-session lapse
findings.detail: useSubscription loads once per page session. If the dashboard shell (trial banner) loaded it while the trial was active, a soft navigation that the proxy redirects to /upgrade-plan seeds from isBlocked=false and picks the default card instead of the stored one. Consider calling refresh() on mount of /upgrade-plan and waiting for it before seeding.

findings.label: Unrelated working-tree changes
findings.detail: tsconfig.json gained .next-verify/types includes, auto-written by the verification build and not mentioned in the verification note. The signup label and docs/ai-connector edits belong to other requests. Keep the tsconfig change out of this change's commit or decide on it deliberately.
